subject: Post-demo: onboarding playbook & procurement checklist for Greenwood
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Mike Sullivan <mike.sullivan@greenwoodhealth.com>
Cc: procurement@greenwoodhealth.com
Date: 2026-09-09T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: onboarding playbook & procurement checklist for Greenwood

Hi Mike — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and an initial onboarding playbook that I promised during the demo. I’ve attached a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft and a vendor forms bundle to make procurement easier on your side. Below are the milestone suggestions and owners we typically use for customers using Coupa/Ariba. Please confirm or edit as needed so we can lock the target close date.

Proposed onboarding milestones (target close: 2026-10-01):
- 1) Vendor intake: Greenwood Procurement submits vendor registration in Coupa/Ariba — owner: Greenwood Procurement — due: 2026-09-13
- 2) Vendor docs & tax: Greenwood provides completed vendor form + W-9 and banking details — owner: Greenwood Finance — due: 2026-09-15
- 3) Contract execution: Redwood sends final order form + attachments; Greenwood returns signed PO or countersigned order — owner: legal/ops — due: 2026-09-20
- 4) Technical onboarding: API keys, test endpoints, and validation plan — owner: Redwood Solutions (I’ll own coordination) — due: 2026-09-24
- 5) Go-live / billing start: production endpoint & agreed billing terms — owner: mutual — target: 2026-10-01

Dependencies and notes:
- Greenwood uses Coupa for vendor onboarding (confirmed on call) — we’ll need the Coupa vendor code or the Ariba supplier request if you route via Ariba.
- W-9 and banking details are usually required to issue the first invoice; a 3-way match is typical. If Greenwood needs our credit application, I attached a one-page form.
- If Greenwood requires a specific PO template, please upload it into Coupa or forward it and we’ll have Finance review.

Attachments: redwood_MAP_draft_Greenwood_v1.pdf (MAP draft, milestone table), vendor_forms.zip (vendor questionnaire + credit app).

Next steps I propose:
1) Mike / Procurement: Confirm vendor portal (Coupa vs. Ariba) and provide the portal vendor request link or contact.
2) Greenwood Finance: Send W-9 and bank remit details by 2026-09-15.
3) Redwood: I’ll share a completed vendor packet and a small checklist for your AP team; loop in Marissa (Finance ops) and Rachel (Legal ops) for any contract redlines.

If this timeline looks good, I’ll update the MAP and send a versioned PDF for signatures.

Thanks — Ben
Benjamin (Ben) Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | (415) 555-0189

Subject: Re: Post-demo: onboarding playbook & procurement checklist for Greenwood

Ben — thanks for the recap and the materials. Couple of clarifying items from procurement: we do use Coupa for vendor onboarding (not Ariba) so please note that on the MAP. For Coupa we’ll need the following from Redwood to create a supplier record:
- DBA / legal name, tax ID (EIN), and remit-to address
- A point of contact for 3-way match questions
- Our AP team will ask for a sample invoice format and payment terms (we typically run Net 45).

Also, we have a supplier questionnaire that must be completed if the annual spend threshold is exceeded — I attached the procurement checklist to this reply (see stub). Can Redwood also complete the credit application you mentioned? I’ll get our finance lead to upload the W-9 request in Coupa, but it helps if you can send the W-9 directly to procurement@greenwoodhealth.com so we can attach it to the vendor record.

On the timing: Coupa onboarding is usually 5–7 business days after we get all required docs. If you can get the vendor packet + W-9 by 9/15 we should be on track for your 10/1 target.

Thanks Mike — appreciate the quick turnaround. Couple items from our side:
- I’ve updated the MAP to mark Coupa as vendor portal (attached vendor_packet_redwood_20260909.pdf). That packet includes our legal info and a one-page credit application — please note we do not include our full bank account numbers in email; instead we provide a bank remittance form for upload to your secure portal.
- For Coupa intake: legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.; EIN: XX-XXXXXXX (we’ll provide full EIN in the secure form); remit name: Redwood Inference; remit address in packet.
- Point of contact for 3-way match / AP validation: accounting@redwood.com (Monica Patel, AP Manager) — I’ve asked Monica to be available if your AP team has questions during setup.
- Invoice cadence: Redwood prefers Net 30 but can agree Net 45 for the first 90 days while onboarding completes; please indicate preferred term and we’ll route through Finance for approval.

Attachments: vendor_packet_redwood_20260909.pdf (Vendor packet + remittance form, 120 KB).

Next ask: Can procurement upload Greenwood’s Coupa vendor request and tag it to vendor name "Redwood Inference" so we can see the request id? If you prefer, we can accept your Coupa invite and submit the supplier form directly.

I’ve cc’d Marissa (Finance ops) and Rachel (Legal ops) to start the internal review of your PO template or any contract redlines.

Best,
Ben

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-11T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: review requested — Greenwood procurement packet and billing terms

Marissa / Rachel — forwarding the thread with Greenwood. Highlights for internal review:
- Greenwood uses Coupa; procurement asked for vendor packet + W-9 uploaded into Coupa. They indicated Net 45 is typical; they said they can accept Net 30 for a short trial period if Finance approves.
- Attachments (see vendor_packet_redwood_20260909.pdf): contains legal name, EIN placeholder, remit-to instructions, and a remit form that will be stored in our secure drive.
- If Finance is ok with Net 45 to start, we should accept to accelerate the win; otherwise request 30-day terms with 45-day pilot clause.
- Rachel: please scan the PO template if Greenwood sends it and note any non-standard indemnities or data residency asks (they mentioned integration with Coupa only).

Action items:
1) Marissa — confirm we can accept Net 45 for first 90 days; if not, what conditions would you need?
2) Rachel — if Greenwood shares a PO or SOW, flag any contract obligations that need negotiation (term, termination, liability caps).

I’ll wait to hear back before committing to Net 45 on the MAP. Thanks — Ben
